newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville peak power prices unchanged to Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville peak power prices unchanged to Thursday.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left its next-day firm and non-firm power prices for peak demand hours unchanged through Thursday, but slighty raised off-peak non-firm offers, BPA said Monday.

For Tuesday through Thursday, firm power during a block of heavy-load hours was still offered at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $19.50 for California-Oregon (COB) and Nevada-Oregon (NOB) border deliveries.
Block firm power during light-load hours was offered at $16.25 for all deliveries, compared with $16.00 for Monday pre-schedulings.
Non-firm power between 0100 and 0500 PDT on Monday was offered at $16.00-17.00 per MWh for all deliveries, and at $18.50 (Northwest) and $20.00 (COB/NOB) between 0700 and 2300 PDT.
